if not moved, the place command cannot take effect."},{"id":"T0095","english":"Before executing the place action, first confirm that you have reached the target container's location via 'go to', then execute the 'put' command."},{"id":"T0096","english":"In a two-object placement task, if already holding one object, directly attempting to pick up the second object usually fails and returns 'Nothing happens'."},{"id":"T0097","english":"The agent can usually hold only one object at a time; while holding one, it cannot pick up another."},{"id":"T0098","english":"Before picking up the second object, first place the object already held into the target container or a temporary placement point;
